opening.argument: The offer is presented as a free iTunes gift card and directs viewers to an external entry flow, while the displayed form requests delivery address, city, ZIP, date of birth, and phone number before submission. The title calls these “Free iTunes gift cards 2020 (no human verification,” and the description supplies a “Free iTunes gift card LINK: http://play.sweepstakesalerts.com/”. The encouragement “IT WORKS 100%” and “TRY IT TODAY” reinforces participation. The evidence establishes the solicitation and collection of personal details, but does not show what happened to submitted information or whether any gift card was delivered.
